result.fix: The CPU shows no avx2. In your own hypervisor, set the VM CPU model to host passthrough (libvirt `<cpu mode='host-passthrough'/>`), turn off VMware EVC masking, or on Hyper-V run `Set-VMProcessor -VMName <name> -CompatibilityForMigrationEnabled $false` on the hypervisor. In a public cloud the CPU model is fixed: pick an instance type whose CPU has it.
